summary: No agency page for the campground exists: Reclamation's Montana Area Office and Montana recreation pages mention only Barretts Diversion Dam, and there is no recreation.gov listing. Nothing changed; free/FCFS/14-day/water/vault toilets/10 sites/45 ft all rest on note prose from tourism listings and an RV-inspection blog.
flags: No agency page: the entry's website (https://www.usbr.gov/gp/mtao/) is the Montana Area Office home page and says nothing about Barretts Park; Reclamation's Montana recreation pages (https://www.usbr.gov/gp/recreation/montana_recreation.html) have no Barretts entry, and there is no recreation.gov facility. Only aggregators and the state tourism listing (VisitMT 'Barretts Station Park Campground': 'Located along Beaverhead River, 5 miles south of Dillon on I-15', tent and trailer sites, accessible restrooms, drinking water, per its search summary) describe it. Every structured value is unverifiable from an official source.
Name: VisitMT and Campendium call it 'Barretts Station Park Campground'; The Dyrt calls it 'Barretts Park - USBR'.
Phone 406-683-6472 appears only on aggregators (Campendium); no official page gives a number.
Facilities caveat (secondary): Dyrt reviewers describe a parking-lot style camping area and report problems with the water pump; not written.
